# Tate Programs

Tate Programs builds practical release-readiness tools and fixed-scope review services for JavaScript, TypeScript, GitHub Action, and MCP server launches.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://tateprograms.com/) - Main workbench, services, proof, and contact paths.
- [Shipcheck CLI](https://tateprograms.com/shipcheck.html) - Static release-readiness scanner for JS, TS, GitHub Action, npm, and MCP repos.
- [MCP Registry Pulse](https://tateprograms.com/mcp-registry-pulse.html) - Public aggregate snapshot of MCP Registry metadata, README, STDIO, auth, and launch-proof signals.
- [MCP Registry Pulse JSON](https://tateprograms.com/mcp-registry-pulse.json) - Machine-readable aggregate data backing the Pulse page.
- [Agent Stack Radar](https://tateprograms.com/agent-stack-radar.html) - May 2026 radar for agent-native software trends: MCP, x402, Pay.sh, live web data, browser automation, coding agents, and machine-readable docs.
- [x402 Launch Checklist](https://tateprograms.com/x402-launch-checklist.html) - Launch-readiness checklist for x402, Pay.sh, and agent-payment demos before real value can move.
- [Pay.sh Catalog Pulse](https://tateprograms.com/pay-sh-catalog-pulse.html) - Live Pay.sh catalog snapshot for agent-paid API provider counts, pricing surfaces, free-tier coverage, and review-priority launch controls.
- [Pay.sh Catalog Pulse JSON](https://tateprograms.com/pay-sh-catalog-pulse.json) - Machine-readable data backing the Pay.sh Catalog Pulse page.
- [x402 Metadata Filter](https://tateprograms.com/x402-metadata-filter.html) - Browser-only filter for payment metadata, prompts, resource URLs, user identifiers, query tokens, and secret-like fields before x402 or Pay.sh demos.
- [Agent Security Drill Kit](https://tateprograms.com/agent-security-drill.html) - Browser-only agent-security evidence console for prompt injection, exfiltration, tool scopes, policy actions, audit trails, A2A agent identity, Gemini-safe integration notes, and exportable review packs.
- [Agent Security Evidence Note](https://tateprograms.com/agent-security-evidence-2026.html) - Field note on why 2026 agent demos need inspectable evidence packs: policy actions, tool boundaries, A2A identity, Gemini-safe testing, audit trails, and human review gates.
- [Agent Security Sample Report](https://tateprograms.com/agent-security-sample-report.html) - Fictional sample review showing boundary map, drill results, policy gaps, audit evidence, and patch order for an agent demo.
- [MCP Launch Review](https://tateprograms.com/mcp-launch-review.html) - Fixed-scope paid MCP package and registry readiness review.
- [MCP Registry Audit](https://tateprograms.com/mcp-registry-audit.html) - Browser-only self-check for MCP registry and server metadata.
- [MCP Directory Checklist](https://tateprograms.com/mcp-directory-checklist.html) - Public checklist for MCP directory submissions.
- [Agent Commerce Gate](https://tateprograms.com/agent-commerce-gate.html) - Browser-only readiness check for x402, Pay.sh, API-payment, and agent-commerce prototypes, including price previews, enforceable spend caps, provider validation, and payment metadata filtering.
- [Agent Commerce Sample Report](https://tateprograms.com/agent-commerce-sample-report.html) - Fictional sample 48-hour readiness report showing spend map, control gaps, launch evidence, and patch order for an x402 payment-agent demo.
- [Release Readiness 2026](https://tateprograms.com/release-readiness-2026.html) - JS/npm/Action/MCP/payment-agent launch-readiness runbook.
- [Student Launch Kit](https://tateprograms.com/student-launch-kit.html) - Browser-only launch checker for student and hackathon projects.
- [Case Studies](https://tateprograms.com/case-studies.html) - Public proof of shipped tools and launch assets.
- [Payments](https://tateprograms.com/payments.html) - Fixed-scope pricing and payment links.

## Repositories And Packages

- [Shipcheck CLI npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/shipcheck-cli) - Public npm package, runnable with `npx --yes shipcheck-cli .`.
- [Shipcheck MCP npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/shipcheck-mcp) - Public MCP server package for running Shipcheck from MCP clients.
- [Shipcheck Action](https://github.com/TateLyman/shipcheck-action) - GitHub Action wrapper for Shipcheck.
- [Shipcheck MCP](https://github.com/TateLyman/shipcheck-mcp) - MCP server source repository.
- [Tate Programs site](https://github.com/TateLyman/tate-web-services) - Static site source.
